newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks shrug off U.S. GDP data.
newsitem.headline: French stocks shrug off U.S. GDP data.

text.p: The French share market held to technical trading, concentrating on the expiry of February futures contracts and largely ignoring the U.S. fourth quarter GDP figures which showed a 3.9 percent rise, dealers said.
Paris would take its steer from Wall Street's opening when expiry business was out of the way, one trader said.

The blue-chip CAC-40 index was down 14.37 points or 0.55 percent at 2,615.03 at 1519 GMT, it had stood down 0.64 percent before the U.S. economic report. The CAC-40 futures contract was down 17 points at 2,616 from Thursday's close.
